newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-NICOL TO LEAD SCOTS INTO AFRICA.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-NICOL TO LEAD SCOTS INTO AFRICA.

text.p: Bath scrum-half Andy Nicol will captain an inexperienced Scotland squad on their six-match tour to Zimbabwe and South Africa in June and July.

The Scots named 14 uncapped players on Wednesday for what they clearly see as a rebuilding exercise following a poor Five Nations season. Among their opponents will be Zimbabwe, Transvaal and Eastern Province.

"We will be taking quite a few who have not even played at A international level, but the squad has been selected with the next World Cup in mind," said Nicol, picked as skipper in the absence of British Lions flanker Rob Wainwright.

Squad: Andy Nicol (captain), Steve Brotherstone, Gordon Bulloch, Graeme Burns, Stewart Campbell, Craig Chalmers, Ronnie Eriksson, Hugh Gilmour, George Graham, Stuart Grimes, Dave Hilton, Duncan Hodge, Carl Hogg, Simon Holmes, Craig Joiner, Derrick Lee, Kenny Logan, Sean Longstaff, Andy Lucking, Cameron Mather, Jamie Mayer, Cameron Murray, Scott Murray, Scott Nichol, Eric Peters, Rowan Shepherd, Ian Smith, Barry Stewart, Mattie Stewart, Peter Walton.
